name: Post Trade Event 1
definition: Information relating to post-trade lifecycle events.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of post trade event.

UnderlyingLiabilityReference.name: Underlying Liability Reference
UnderlyingLiabilityReference.definition: Related underlying liability, for example a commercial trade.

ProfitOrLossSettlementDate.name: Profit Or Loss Settlement Date
ProfitOrLossSettlementDate.definition: Date on which any profit or loss arising from the post-trade event will be settled.

ProfitOrLoss.name: Profit Or Loss
ProfitOrLoss.definition: Amount of profit or loss that is to be settled, after any adjustments have taken place.

OutstandingSettlementAmount.name: Outstanding Settlement Amount
OutstandingSettlementAmount.definition: Amount that remains to be settled, in the specified currency if a trade is partially delivered early or partially unwound.
